description: This PHP test file contains a class LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest that tests LDAP connection functionalities, specifically anonymous binding and handling invalid host/port scenarios, within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It sets up LDAP server configurations, switches server settings to allow anonymous binds, and runs multiple test cases.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying LDAP anonymous connection functionality and error handling for invalid host and port configurations in the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests run, checks LDAP server configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Per-test setup, loads LDAP configuration if not already done.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Configures the LDAP server to allow anonymous bind, sets size limit, and loads test user data.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests that a connection using anonymous LDAP bind works successfully.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with an invalid host IP, expects ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with an invalid port, expects ConnectionException.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with SSL encryption forced, expecting failure.
